name: Celeste
source:
"I will never forget. I will [i]never[/i] forgive."

Celeste, the playable character, a woman determined to make her enemies pay for their crimes. The longer the quest for revenge, the closer you’ll get to uncovering the truth. Revelations that surpass even your wildest fantasies will become your reality.

Hell hath no fury like a woman scorned, and you will not forget the betrayals inflicted upon you. With a mark that ties your fate to seven men, you’re determined to lay waste those who sought to shatter you. Will you try again, no matter how long it takes?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/eternallovestudios/shattered-souls-a-dark-fantasy-isekai-otome]Kickstarter[/url]]
